purpose: Host behaviour controls for the receive frame composition. Each mutant changes a real consume call site while leaving every helper body and every law untouched, so no law is expected to fail. Rejection is enforced by a semantic fixture: the positive artifact must build and pass, the mutant must build successfully, and only then may a named fixture assertion be reported as failing.
scope: bend2/src/coordinator/turn.bend only. Do not alter helper bodies, laws, or any CI/shared checker or evidence API.
artifacts_exe_note: receive.py hardcodes EXE to this checkout's .scratch/bend2/baton2 and skips tests when that binary is missing, so every run must preflight and record the SHA-256 of that exact artifact.

evidence_inputs.note: RetainedReplay skips its class when BATON_RETAINED_LOGS is unset or not a directory. A skip is not acceptance: the remote recipe must set the variable, record the SHA-256 of each required file, and treat a skip as a failure of the run.

controls.name: consume-bypasses-the-activity-update
controls.why: With the activity state never advancing, the terminal's elided tail keeps no recorded assistant activity, so the retained completion is no longer the activity the stream reached last and the normalizer reports the unavailable frame instead of 'Complete answer.'.

controls.name: consume-bypasses-terminal-normalization
controls.why: The terminal frame reaches the store unnormalized, so a truncated terminal never recovers the retained completion and the report no longer carries 'Full retained report.' or 'Complete answer.'.

controls.name: consume-propagates-empty-activity
controls.why: The activity state is dropped on every recursion, so the multi-frame sequence loses the assistant activity it accumulated and the normalizer cannot establish which completion the stream reached last.

controls.name: consume-propagates-the-previous-activity
controls.why: The replacement forwards the state the recursion received, so the state this frame computed never reaches the next frame. retained_output initializes that state empty, so by induction it stays empty for every frame: the normalizer sees no observed activity, cannot justify the retained completion, and the ordered later-failure fixture is predicted to report the unavailable frame rather than the later failure. This prediction is not a measurement. The control shares its target text with the empty-activity control and is distinguished only by its replacement.

remote_recipe: positive: BEND=/admitted/toolchain/bin/bend sh bend2/scripts/build-native.sh ; require exit 0 ; record shasum -a 256 .scratch/bend2/baton2
positive fixtures: BATON_RETAINED_LOGS=<log dir> python3 bend2/test/receive-retained-replay.py <named cases> -v ; require OK and no skip

per mutant: copy the exact source tree, assert the find string occurs exactly once, apply the replacement, then BEND=/admitted/toolchain/bin/bend sh bend2/scripts/build-native.sh ; require exit 0 before reading any fixture result, else the control is inconclusive

per mutant: record shasum -a 256 .scratch/bend2/baton2 in the copy, then run the named target fixtures once with BATON_RETAINED_LOGS set, and retain that single run's command, full raw output, process exit and assertion text as the control's actual result ; any later re-run is a separate owned execution with its own record and is never merged into the first
formal gate: BEND=/admitted/toolchain/bin/bend node bend2/scripts/laws-check.mjs with no outer timeout ; read the final aggregate and the actual process exit, not a trailing proof-removal line

replay_boundary.obligation: Recovery reconstructs message, terminal and input state while materializing each intended public frame once. The raw spool stays authoritative, and identical native frames at different byte positions stay distinct because text deduplication would erase valid output.
replay_boundary.known_behavior: A recovered observer that revisits a previously projected spool prefix appends that selected prefix to the public log again, and repeated generations amplify it. Ownership of the projection frontier is a host concern outside this file.
replay_boundary.not_defined_here: No record-suppression flag is defined: retained_output also serves fresh retained starts and live tail, so suppressing records there would drop output that was never recorded.

control_expectations.note: Driver metadata: for each control, the discriminating assertion is expected to fail while the positive artifact passes; a companion inverse case is expected to remain passing under the same mutant and exists to catch over-broad corrections. A named failure counts only after a successful mutant build and a passing positive run; a missing target, a skip, an unrelated exception or a compiler error is inconclusive.

immutable_inputs.note: Local hashes of the captured files in the shared logs directory, declared as the recipe's required inputs. The recipe fails on a changed hash, a missing artifact or any skipped test; a live file that still changes is never pinned as frozen.

reported_limits: No mutation in this file has been executed. Nothing here claims a run, a rejection, or a pass.
Local execution of the runner, builds or fixtures is not permitted; these definitions are inputs to an admitted remote run.
